name: Port Authority of Thailand (PAT)
via: state enterprise under the Ministry of Transport
note: State enterprise of Thailand under the Ministry of Transport, established in B.E. 2494 (1951) to operate the country's ports (Ministry of Transport data catalog). The PAT seal is on the front of Port FC's 2026-27 home shirt above the manufacturer logo, and PAT heads the club's own list of 19 official sponsors for 2026/27.
